[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (lst: List Int) : Option Int :=
if lst.length ≤ 1 then
  none
else
  let mut min1 := Int.max_value
  let mut min2 := Int.max_value
  for elem in lst do
    if elem < min1 then
      min2 := min1
      min1 := elem
    else if elem < min2 && elem ≠ min1 then
      min2 := elem
  if min2 = Int.max_value then
    none
  else
    some min2
[END]

List.foldl (λ x y, if x < y then x else y) (Int.max_value) (lst.filter (· < min1)) = min2 ∧
List.foldl (λ x y, if x < y then x else y) (Int.max_value) (lst.filter (· < min2)) = Int.max_value :=
